summary: Diff implements Firestore-based role/approval gating, adds Super Admin menu entry to reach admin users screen, and introduces a pending-approval screen with the required phrase. Admin pending-users UI and details dialog are added, but the exact Firestore field-update semantics for approve/reject are not evidenced in the provided diff summary, and several extra admin moderation features appear unrequested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Approving sets `approved=true` (and clears `rejected`), rejecting sets `rejected=true` and keeps `approved=false`.
missing_requirements.reason: UI actions exist, but the diff summary does not show the Firestore update logic (e.g., clearing `rejected` on approve or ensuring `approved=false` on reject). The hook or mutation implementation is not included in the shown snippets.

missing_requirements.requirement: After performing an action, the pending list refreshes and the updated user no longer appears as pending when approved.
missing_requirements.reason: The screen uses a hook (`useFirestorePendingUsersList`) and has action callbacks, but the diff summary does not provide evidence of refetch/invalidation logic or that the query is filtered strictly to `approved == false` after mutation.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin actions to Block User and Promote to Helper Admin.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks for approve/reject pending users; block/promote flows are additional moderation features not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Clickable super-admin avatar directly navigates to /admin/users.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 specifies an explicit navigation item in the profile/avatar dropdown; direct navigation on avatar click is an extra behavior not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Pending screen claims an email notification will be sent upon approval.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goal states not to implement real email notifications; while no integration is shown, the UI text asserts an email notification will occur, which is beyond the requested scope and may be misleading.
